title: Collapse
text: Collapse. I love DII baskets, but these are just cheaper feeling than all my others. They are laminated cotton fabric, but the fabric is a tight weave, not a thick weave. They still work, they just don’t hold their shape very well at all. I find them constantly collapsing, even when they have things in them. I think the fabric is just too thin for this use. Or they needed an actual liner or something.
